test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**focus**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the recent trend seen on social media towards hyper positivity.
 
• The appropriate noun should indicate the direction or emphasis that social media has placed on this trend.
 
• "**Focus**" fits well as it denotes a central point or concentration on hyper positivity, which aligns with the context.
 
• Other options ("**blemish**", "**disregard**", "**dispersion**") do not fit the context of describing the emphasis on hyper positivity.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *As community-minded creatures who want deeply to belong, we often mirror others, including on social media, where we adopt phrasing, tone and expressions of emotion. In the past few years, social media has had a focus on hyper positivity: think cheery emojis and inspirational quotes plastered over sunsets. Some put this 'good vibes only' trend down to the pandemic and a desire to avoid painful feelings when reflecting on difficult realities. However, attempting to convey constant happiness is not only difficult but impossible.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Blemish" refers to an imperfection and does not fit the context of emphasis on hyper positivity.
 
• "Disregard" means lack of consideration and does not convey the idea of emphasis.
 
• "Dispersion" refers to spreading out and does not align with the notion of focus or emphasis.
